build_tf2jax_package: build the tf2jax python package using setuptools setup.py install script
create_tf2jax_version: create a version string by parsing __version__ from tf2jax/__init__.py
parse_tf2jax_requirements: parse requirements from requirements.txt excluding comments and blank lines
find_tf2jax_packages: find all tf2jax packages excluding test files with setuptools find_packages
configure_tf2jax_setup: configure the tf2jax package metadata including name, version, license, and classifiers
